entries.proposition: TEXT CLAIM NOT SHOWN BY ITS PANEL: the text says HYAL1 mRNA is increased in WWOX-knockdown cells, but Figure 1c shows Hyal-1 in the siWwox cells at the level of the scramble control and reduced only in the WWOX-overexpressing cells.
entries.snippet: In contrast, HYAL1 mRNA transcripts were increased in WWOX-knockdown cells (Fig. 1c).
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX downregulation induces hyaluronidase production and increases cell migration in vivo

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1C AS DRAWN: Wwox mRNA bars (scramble about 1, siWwox about 0.2, Wwox about 3.7) and Hyal-1 mRNA bars (scramble about 1.0, siWwox about 0.9, Wwox about 0.4); only the Wwox group is marked significant for Hyal-1. Hyal-2 mRNA has no bar chart (only gel bands in 1b). Values read from the axes, approximate.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1c: Hyal-1 mRNA scramble about 1.0, siWwox about 0.9 (no increase), Wwox about 0.4 (marked); no Hyal-2 bar chart; Figure 1b gel bands for Hyal-1 and Hyal-2 look similar across lanes. Values read from the axes, approximate.

entries.proposition: THE HYAL-2 HEADLINE RESTS ON IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY OF TUMOUR SECTIONS, not on mRNA: about 100 percent increase in the knockdown tumours and about 15 percent reduction in the overexpressing ones.
entries.snippet: Tumor lesions showed that Hyal-2 was significantly upregulated in the WWOX knockdown BCC cells (Fig. 1d; ~100% increase).
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX downregulation induces hyaluronidase production and increases cell migration in vivo

entries.proposition: DESIGN OF THE TUMOUR EXPERIMENT: five animals per clone were implanted but tumour volume is given for three per group; the first growth curve is a single skin carcinoma line.
entries.snippet: Tumor volume was measured (3 per group) twice per week
entries.anchor: Materials and methods, Tumorigenicity assay in nude mice

entries.proposition: BFGF EFFECT IS CONFINED TO 2 PERCENT SERUM: the text says so, and Figure 2g and 2h show the ratio at 4, 6, 8 and 10 percent serum without a marked difference, while the abstract states the secretion as a general consequence of ectopic WWOX.
entries.snippet: As low as 2% serum in the medium, EGFP-WWOX-expressing cells secreted greater amounts of bFGF than control cells (Fig. 2g, h).
entries.anchor: Results, Apoptotic stress caused by overexpressed WWOX allows BCC cells to secrete bFGF for capillary tube formation

entries.proposition: FIGURE 2H AS DRAWN: bFGF ratio (EGFP-WWOX over EGFP) about 1.9 at 2 percent serum (asterisk, n = 4), about 1.1 at 4, about 1.45 at 6, about 0.65 at 8 and about 1.2 at 10 percent, none of the last four marked. Values read from the axes, approximate.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2h: bFGF ratio about 1.9 at 2 percent serum (asterisk, p<0.01, n = 4), about 1.1 at 4, about 1.45 at 6, about 0.65 at 8 and about 1.2 at 10 percent serum, unmarked. Values read from the axes, approximate.

entries.proposition: WNT 'ACTIVATION' IS A REPORTER READ-OUT: a TCF/LEF fluorescent promoter reporter followed by time-lapse microscopy; the figure shows one series without error bars; no beta-catenin level, no GSK3 phosphorylation. The text gives 'within 4 h' where the figure legend says 'in less than 2 h'. WO-22 stays OPEN.
entries.snippet: In the MDA-MB-231/L929 coculture, rapid activation of Wnt/β-catenin-dependent TCF/LEF promoter occurred within 4 h and reached a maximal extent in 48 h in MDA-MB-231, but not in L929 (Fig. 4d).
entries.anchor: Results, Activation of Wnt-dependent TCF/LEF promoter in MDA-MB-231 allows them to dodge L929

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4D AND 4H AS DRAWN: TCF/LEF reporter fluorescence of MDA-MB-231 rises from about 5 to about 20 units over 48 h and stays flat for L929, one series per cell type, no error bars; XAV939 panels show single-cell tracks (letters A, S, C) without a replicate count.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4d: TCF/LEF promoter fluorescence for MDA-MB-231 rising from about 5 to about 20 over 48 h, L929 flat, single series, no error bars; Figure 4h tracks labelled A, S and C, no replicate number.

entries.proposition: THE 'WWOX-POSITIVE KILLED' STORY IS ACCOMPANIED BY THE AUTHORS' OWN REPORT THAT THE WWOX-NEGATIVE CELLS DIE LATER.
entries.snippet: Similar results were observed with Wwox knockout MEF cells upon encountering with wild type MEF cells.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph on MIF and redox activity

entries.proposition: FIGURE 6C AS DRAWN: in the knockout and wild-type coculture the wild-type side reaches about 129 of 223 cells (about 58 percent) apoptotic at 60 h and the knockout side about 68 of 183 (about 37 percent) against about 20 to 25 percent on each side of the wild-type pair; the text calls the knockout cells low in redox activity but they too die. Counts read from the plotted labels.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 6c: wild-type against wild-type about 107 of 466 and 97 of 485 apoptotic at 60 h; knockout against wild-type, wild-type side 129 of 223 and knockout side 68 of 183 at 60 h. Counts read from the plotted labels.

entries.proposition: THE 'WWOX RESTORED' EXPERIMENT USES A GENOME-WIDE DEMETHYLATING AGENT with no WWOX-specific control; WWOX is shown in one blot (Figure 6f).
entries.snippet: We induced WWOX expression in MDA-MB-231 by treating with 5-aza-2′-deoxycytidine (5-aza) to suppress promoter methylation for 5 days.
entries.anchor: Results, Induction of WWOX in MDA-MB-231 cells by a methylation inhibitor allows the cells to fend off parental WWOX-negative cells

entries.proposition: GENERALISATION FROM UNPUBLISHED PAIRS: the sentence that WWOX-negative cells cannot recognise WWOX-positive cells of any species rests on more than fifteen pairs 'unpublished'.
entries.snippet: WWOX- cells can no longer recognize the parental cells or WWOX+ cells of the same or different species (using >15 pairs of cells tested thus far; unpublished).

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3F AS DRAWN: mean velocities with p values (4.6 x 10^-6, 0.0003, 0.0451) from n = 10 randomly selected cells per condition; the cell pair is a human line against a mouse line in the headline case.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3f: mean velocity bars for MDA-MB-231 against L929, knockout against wild-type MEF and knockout against knockout, p = 4.6 x 10^-6, 0.0003 and 0.0451, n = 10 cells.
